Group rides in Delaware

4 recurring group rides around Delaware: 3 road, 1 gravel, 1 social. 3 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Friday Brewery Gravel Trail Ride (Sussex Cyclists) in Lewes. Want to go fast? Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists) runs 16 mph and 17 mph groups.
